author: Miltownman
quote:
This game is unbelievably boring. The story is lackluster, the characters are bland and uninteresting, and the experience is riddled with bugs and glitches. The idea of doing mundane chores in a game called Grand Theft Auto is honestly ridiculous. Somewhere along the way, the developers seem to have forgotten the most important part of making a video game: it's supposed to be fun.

Instead, they've focused on tedious life-simulator mechanics that do nothing but drag down the experience. Neither of the main characters has a particularly interesting personality, and it's difficult to find either of them likable or worth investing in. Between the uninspired story, forgettable characters, repetitive busywork, and technical issues, this game has very little to offer. Unfortunately, it feels like they forgot what made Grand Theft Auto enjoyable in the first place.
